summary: Verify every completion claim against the actual requested requirements and observed check results.

steps.intent: Inspect the changed path and the exact requirements before selecting checks.
Run the narrowest relevant available checks and capture their actual exit status and output.
Compare every requested requirement with the observed evidence; distinguish passed, failed, skipped and not-run checks.
Repair verified failures or clearly report unresolved failures and missing runtime acceptance.

behavior_constraints.expected_behavior: Do not claim a change works, is fixed or is tested until a relevant check was actually run and its result inspected; otherwise state that it was not run.
Keep failed, skipped, cancelled and not-run checks distinct; repair the failure or report it without relabeling it as a pass.
Compare each requested requirement with concrete evidence and explicitly list anything not met or not checked.
